msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia lanas-cachemir-24.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of handmade knitted wool shawls with long fluffy fringes draped over a wooden chair from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia lanas-cachemir-16.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a black knitted wool shawl with a long fringe (flat lay) from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia lanas-cachemir-15.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a beige lace knitted shawl (flat lay) from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a cream knitted wool shawl with a long fluffy mohair fringe, folded (flat lay) from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia lanas-cachemir-33.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of an orange knitted shawl with a long brown fringe hung on a branch from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
